_about: QA gate record for the capstone engagement. Fictional, like the client. The failure and its fix are recorded on purpose: the record is the evidence.

checks.name: First reply sent within 5 minutes on Instagram test enquiries
First reply sent within 5 minutes on WhatsApp test enquiries
First reply sent within 5 minutes on website test enquiries
Qualification answers match the client price list exactly
No price is ever invented for an unlisted treatment
Booking writes the correct diary slot with the client's details

checks.finding: The follow-up sequence sent its second step to a test lead who had opted out after the first step. Opt-outs were checked at enrolment, not at send time.
checks.fix: Stop-condition check added: before every sequence send, the system re-reads the opt-out flag at send time, and a set flag ends the sequence for that lead permanently.
checks.name: Follow-up sequence honours opt-outs at send time
checks.retest_note: Retested on the original failing case plus two neighbouring cases (opt-out before enrolment, opt-out between steps two and three). All three now stop correctly.

checks.name: Clinical suitability questions route to a human, unanswered by the agent
Out of hours enquiries receive the same quality of reply as daytime ones
Duplicate enquiries on two channels are merged, not answered twice
Human hand-off includes the full conversation summary
